name: restricted-site-access
description: Limit access to visitors who are logged in or allowed by IP addresses. Includes many options for handling blocked visitors.

scripts.test:php: wp-env --config=.wp-env.test.json run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/restricted-site-access vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.xml.dist --exclude-group ms-required
scripts.test:php:multisite: wp-env --config=.wp-env.test.json run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/restricted-site-access env WP_MULTISITE=1 vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.xml.dist
scripts.test:php:network: wp-env --config=.wp-env.test.json run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/restricted-site-access env WP_MULTISITE=1 RSA_TESTS_NETWORK=1 vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.xml.dist --testsuite network
